name: [3 HOURS] Jump Stars ⚔️
desc:
⭐ Welcome to Jump Stars
Jump into a fast-paced fighting game where every character has their own style, abilities, and combos. Unlock fighters, build your loadouts, and prove you're the strongest.

🎮 How to Play
- Choose your first fighter and hop into a match
- Play games to earn Gems, then summon new characters
- Upgrade characters with Yen and StarPoints
- Customize your abilities and create your own build
- Power up every fighter and max out all of your fighters
- Climb trophies to get to the top of the leaderbaords

🖥️ PC Controls
- Q to Dash
- LMB to Attack
- F to Super Attack
- E to use your Gadget

Tags: Action, Anime, Arena, Fighting, MOBA, Battlegrounds, Fast, PVP, Brawl
